contexts.text: To bless = to be enriched with every earthly and corporeal good.
Here it is said that the doctrine of faith was enriched...

To be blessed, when predicated of man, = to be enriched with spiritual and celestial good; and he is enriched with it when the things which are with him from the Lord are disposed into spiritual and celestial order...

These simple good Spirits were enriched with the truths and goods before possessed by evil Genii and Spirits; for, in the other life, to be enriched with truths and goods is effected by means of the adjunction of Spirits who are in truth and good...
When a man is being regenerated, his enrichment in good is nothing else than insinuation into angelic Societies...
Thus by giving to him that asketh, an Angel is not deprived, but is enriched with goods...
Hence she was enriched with the good of truth. Signified.
Everything can be infinitely varied, thus be enriched by means of various things...
The human and angelic mind is of such a nature, that it can be enriched to eternity; and as it is enriched, so it is perfected. Explained.
Rich-dives and to be enriched () = fully to know and understand such things as are of the Church and of Heaven...
To be enriched and to have need of nothing () = to know all things, so that nothing is wanting.
That they are enriched, is signified by God filleth them with good things.
